_comment: Touge Nights' car lots (see docs/modding.md, "dealers"). mapX/mapY: fractions of dealers/map.jpg from its top left.
showroomId: an AC showroom every install has (measured in dealers/showrooms.json).

dealers.name: Takasaki Auto Gallery
dealers.blurb: Clean, low-mileage imports under bright lights. Every car has its papers, and its price shows it.

dealers.name: Maebashi Used Cars
dealers.blurb: Rows of commuter cars, and round the back, whatever the young guys traded in when they got married.

dealers.name: Shibukawa Motors
dealers.blurb: A family lot at the foot of the pass. The old man buys what comes down the mountain in one piece.

dealers.name: Garage Hayate
dealers.blurb: A tuner's lot: built cars only, turbos, cages and coilovers, sold by the men who built them.

dealers.name: Isesaki Auction Yard
dealers.blurb: Auction leftovers by the dozen, sold as they stand. Bring a torch and a friend who knows engines.
